build_roi_heads: build ROIHeads from config using build_roi_heads with cfg and input_shape
select_foreground_proposals: select foreground proposals from a list of Instances filtering out background and ignore labels
select_proposals_with_visible_keypoints: select proposals that contain at least one visible keypoint inside their bounding boxes

review_Res5ROIHeads_forward: review the Res5ROIHeads forward method for shared Res5 block feature extraction and box mask prediction
